description: This Java class 'ResourceIdentifier' provides a way to parse, construct, and manipulate resource identifiers within the Hono framework. It supports creating identifiers from strings, components (endpoint, tenant, resource), and path segments, as well as retrieving parts like the endpoint, tenant ID, resource ID, and string representations. The class encapsulates resource path segments, handles optional segments, and offers utility methods for formulating and comparing resource identifiers.

classes.name: ResourceIdentifier
classes.description: A class representing a unique identifier for a resource within Hono, capable of parsing and constructing resource paths.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a ResourceIdentifier from a resource string, splitting it into parts.

methods.name: fromStringAssumingDefaultTenant
methods.description: Creates a ResourceIdentifier assuming a default tenant, with the tenant ID defaulted.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a ResourceIdentifier from endpoint, tenantId, and resourceId components.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint part of the resource identifier.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Returns the tenant ID if present.

methods.name: getResourceId
methods.description: Returns the resource ID if present.

methods.name: toPath
methods.description: Returns the resource path as an array of segments.

methods.name: elementAt
methods.description: Returns the path element at a specific index.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the number of segments in the resource path.

methods.name: getBasePath
methods.description: Returns the base path consisting of endpoint and tenant ID.

methods.name: getPathWithoutBase
methods.description: Returns the path segments excluding the base path.

methods.name: hasEventEndpoint
methods.description: Checks if the endpoint is an event endpoint.
